description: Core jQuery library source code defining the jQuery function, prototype methods, utility functions, and internal variables.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the jQuery object to a true array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index or all elements as an array.

methods.name: pushStack
methods.description: Creates a new jQuery object from an array of elements, maintaining chainability.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Executes a callback for each element in the set.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Creates a new jQuery object by applying a callback to each element.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Reduces the set to a subset specified by arguments.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Gets the first element in the set.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Gets the last element in the set.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Gets the element at the specified index.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the most recent filtering operation in the chain.
